messages:
maria: Draft PRD uploaded -> https://redwood.docs/prd/phased-release-guardrails (look for section 'Experiment slate'). Need engineering + SRE signoff on rollout guardrails and acceptance criteria. Short: phased launch for model-v2 (8B) replacing model-v1 (7B) with tenant-scoped experiments and automatic fallback. :eyes:

jordan: skimmed. can we add explicit KV-cache warmup step? last time cold-cache spikes p95.

maria: good catch — added warmup in 'pre-rollout steps'. thinking: 10k synthetic tokens per instance and a 5m drain window before switching to >0.5% traffic.

samir: infra notes: suggest canary pods pinned to a single AZ for first 10m to limit blast radius. need autoscale-policy bump for v2 (2x) during ramp. also: define rollback triggers precisely.

kevin: metric suggestions: latency_p95, error_rate(5xx+timeouts), semantic_quality_delta (eval set), and customer-flagged regressions. define thresholds per stage.

linda: customer safety: tenants must be able to opt out of experiments and opt back in. we need a pin-expiry window so customers don't stay pinned indefinitely. propose default pin_duration = 24h.

maria: agree. proposed acceptance criteria (first pass):
- Stage 0 (smoke): 1% internal traffic, pass sanity check (no 5xx, sanity QA tasks) -> duration 30m.
- Stage 1 (gradual): 1% -> 10% over 2h, monitor metrics.
- Stage 2 (broader): 10% -> 50% over 6h if thresholds ok.
- Full: >95% on day+ if no regressions for 24h and quality stable.

jordan: for rollout config I sketched a policy block, paste here:
```yaml
rollout_policy:
  stages:
    - name: smoke
      target_pct: 1
      duration_min: 30
      pins_allowed: false
    - name: ramp
      target_pct: 10
      duration_min: 120
      pin_duration_hr: 24
    - name: broad
      target_pct: 50
      duration_min: 360
  fallback_model: model-v1
  abort_rules:
    - metric: latency_p95
      threshold_ms: 1200
      comparator: '>'
      window_min: 10
    - metric: error_rate
      threshold_pct: 0.8
      comparator: '>'
      window_min: 5
    - metric: semantic_quality_delta
      threshold_pct: -1.5
      comparator: '<'
      window_min: 60
```

maria: that looks good. add one more rule: if >3 distinct tenant-flagged regressions in 1h -> immediate abort.

samir: ops details: when abort fires, traffic should failover to fallback_model with zero token loss. we need KV cache compatibility check; if models have incompatible cache shape, then abort must trigger full instance restart path. call that out in playbook.

kevin: on experiment design — need statistical power calc for semantic_quality_delta. for small tenants we can't rely on per-tenant signals; include global aggregated eval plus per-tenant sentinel tests. recommend minimum N=200 prompts per stage for significance.

linda: pinning policy: pins are OK for debugging, but should auto-expire. propose admin API to extend pin (max 72h) and automated audit log. also require a 'pin-reason' field.

maria: edge cases to call out in PRD:
- model rollback that partially succeeded (some tenants pinned to v2 while global fallback to v1) -> need reconciliation job that unpins stale pins after rollback.
- region divergence when one region passes and another aborts -> allow region-scoped fallback.
- A/B contamination: ensure model weights aren't mixing via shared caches.

jordan: implementation notes: routing layer needs to support tenant-scoped traffic masks and time-limited pins. will add feature flag to gate rollout code.

rollout-bot: checklist generated:
- validate pre-rollout canary infra (autoscale, AZ pinning) :white_check_mark:
- run synthetic warmup job: pending
- create experiment in console with metrics hooks: pending
- register abort-handlers and playbook: pending

maria: asks: who volunteers to finalize the abort thresholds and the playbook steps? we need a concrete playbook before scheduling cutover. target cutover Thu 09:00 PT. :rocket:

samir: I can draft playbook steps (runbooks + run command list) by EOD tomorrow. will include restart path if cache incompat.

kevin: I'll run the power analysis and propose per-stage minimum sample sizes and recommended sentinel prompts. deliver Tue.

linda: I'll draft pin expiry UX + admin API spec and add opt-out flow for tenants.

jordan: I'll finish feature-flagged rollout code and add e2e test for pin/unpin behavior.

maria: perfect. i'll update PRD with these changes and ping again for final signoff. thanks all :thumbsup:
